observations: Photo 0 shows a large, weathered marine engine on a concrete surface, surrounded by other machinery.
The engine has a prominent front-mounted flywheel and a large, rusted air intake or exhaust component.
The engine body is painted light green or grey, with visible rust and wear, especially on the lower front section.
There are wires and hoses connected to the engine, some of which are frayed or damaged.
The engine appears to be in a yard or workshop setting, with other industrial equipment in the background.
No visible branding or model number is readable on the engine in the photo.

claims.evidence: No visible branding or model number on the engine in photo 0. The seller's text is not proof.

risks.risk: Engine may not be functional or may have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the engine running, or a close-up of the engine's serial number and condition of internal components.

risks.risk: Engine may have been salvaged from a wrecked or accident-damaged vessel.
risks.proof: Photo of the engine's serial number and any documentation or tags indicating its origin.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown origin, which may reduce value

risks.risk: Engine may have been exposed to saltwater or marine environment, leading to corrosion or oil contamination.
risks.proof: Close-up of the oil pan, cylinder head, and exhaust manifold for signs of corrosion or residue.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially contaminated, which may reduce value

proof_requests: Photo of the engine's serial number and any visible branding or model label.
Video or photo of the engine running.
Close-up of the oil pan, cylinder head, and exhaust manifold for signs of corrosion or contamination.
Photo of any documentation or tags indicating the engine's origin.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
